physical_constraints: Cynthion target VBUS switching does not power-cycle the battery-powered FM-1 CPU.
If the unit cannot return to an admissible USB state, retain all evidence and wait for an owner physical reset or separately reviewed recovery-entry procedure.
No blanket erase, eFuse command, replacement SPL/OTA/cfg, unreviewed loader or arbitrary vendor command is authorized.
procedure: On a stopped chain, preserve exclusive marker, every child intent/exit, stdout, capture, original campaign, commands and journal. Never retry the consumed chain.
Inspect actual descendant and capture termination. Classify the actual failure direction as INSTALL or admitted stock RESTORE. Hash actual evidence without altering original timestamps.

Only a caught child failure with complete owned terminal capture and the retained same fixed-loader USB/SG connection is admissible. Obtain a fresh passive same-binding witness; run the pinned file-only helper on actual evidence before any opener.

Use a new exclusive acquisition receipt at the direction-specific path and the pinned no-upload capture wrapper. Acquire two full matching partial dumps using exactly 8707 FC0A/FD05 exchanges. No loader upload, reset, erase or program occurs in acquisition.

Validate all bytes outside authenticated uncertain spans and all protected stock regions. Require completed acquisition provenance and a new fresh same-loader witness before preparing the distinct stock_restore transaction.

Use a new direct restore receipt under completed acquisition and the pinned owned restore wrapper. Restore exact original stock within the original 30-sector whitelist, with directory sector 0x4000 last if dirty. Preserve the failed original journal.

Require successful native SG completions, page readback, zero unresolved write uncertainty and complete final stock readback. Separately verify stock boot; a full-stock hash alone does not prove boot or display.
refuse_automatic_recovery_on: Disconnected or newly enumerated ROM connection
Crash or missing terminal owned capture
Unexpected command, changed source, ambiguous journal or protected-byte corruption
Failure during this partial acquisition or partial restore; nested readmission unsupported
required_acceptance_before_launch: Terminal V6r heavy model evidence retained and verified
Exact accepted source integration and required exact-head CI
Concrete launch/source closure review and all four literal authority pins
Fresh real normal-mode USB binding and unused root-owned run directories
